summary: Flip space is a digital flipbook telling the story of NASA’s Mars rover, Opportunity (Oppy), under the theme "Left Behind, Not Forgotten." To address the challenge of making space science engaging, we transformed real NASA mission data and Martian imagery into an illustrated, page-turning story of Oppy’s 15-year journey. This project is important because it turns complex space history into an emotional narrative, inspiring future explorers and ensuring Oppy’s legacy is never forgotten.
details: FLIP SPACE is a digital flipbook project by Valkyrie Space that tells the story of NASA's Opportunity rover and its exploration of Mars. The project uses a series of real images from NASA's Planetary Data System (PDS) and NASA Image Library to create frame-by-frame animation, allowing viewers to follow Opportunity's movements and learn about its mission, discoveries, and challenges. Through interactive visual storytelling, Flip Space makes space science more accessible and exciting for young people. It helps students learn about Mars exploration, understand how a rover works, and develop an interest in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM). The project was developed on a Windows computer, focusing on digital flipbook design and page-flipping effects without requiring programming languages. Its creativity lies in transforming scientific images and information into an engaging storytelling experience that combines technology, art, and education. Throughout development, our team considered scientific accuracy, educational value, creativity, accessibility, and emotional impact. We hope to inspire younger generations to explore space and remember Opportunity's valuable contributions, because even though its mission has ended, its discoveries will live on. A mission may end, but discoveries live forever.
